tasks.label: Isaac: tail log
tasks.command: $f = @((Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'Documents'), [Environment]::GetFolderPath('MyDocuments')) | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $_ 'My Games\Binding of Isaac Repentance+\log.txt' } | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ } | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $f) { Write-Error 'Isaac log.txt not found in Documents or OneDrive Documents'; exit 1 }; Get-Content -Path $f -Wait -Tail 30 | Select-String 'TLOST_DOUBLE_HC|Error'
